CommunityApplications.Profile:
Dupearr finds duplicate movies and TV episodes in Plex, adds what Radarr and Sonarr know about every copy, keeps the best one according to your own rules and removes the others: through the Radarr/Sonarr instance that owns the file, through Plex, or into its own recycle bin.
It is built around not losing data. Dry run and manual approval are on by default, recent files are never touched, every run is capped, the kept copy is re-verified right before each removal, and every action is logged.
This repository holds the Dupearr source code and its Unraid template. Image: ghcr.io/sl0wz3r/dupearr:latest
